“Hundreds of posts all throughout the night, and it‘s impossible not to connect that to the absolute inattention that he paid, laziness, towards the run-up to the war in Iran,” he said. Rose claimed Trump ignored factors, including the affordability crisis in the U.S. and the fact that a war in the Middle East would likely affect gas prices before going ahead with his attack on Iran.
